translations.web: but if it bears thorns and thistles, it is rejected and near being cursed, whose end is to be burned.
translations.bsb: But land that produces thorns and thistles is worthless, and its curse is imminent. In the end it will be burned.
translations.kjv: But that which beareth thorns and briers is rejected, and is nigh unto cursing; whose end is to be burned.
translations.asv: but if it beareth thorns and thistles, it is rejected and nigh unto a curse; whose end is to be burned.
